text: Reflection-agent atomic handshake failure: reflection-agent may complete full analysis (writing to reflection-log.jsonl, producing report) but fail to return processedReflectionIds in TaskUpdate metadata. When this happens, reflection-spawn-request.json retains the processed IDs indefinitely, causing the Router to re-spawn reflection-agent on every subsequent prompt. Root cause: reflection-agent TaskUpdate(completed) was not called or did not include processedReflectionIds. Fix: always verify atomic handshake by checking reflection-spawn-request.json is cleared after reflection completes. Prevention: reflection-cleanup.cjs hook checks for processedReflectionIds in TaskUpdate metadata.

Canary-first framework rollout: when rolling out a new pattern to multiple SKILL.md files, start with the lowest-risk artifact (schema-creator: trivial NOTE-tier change), validate the pattern lands correctly, then expand to higher-impact artifacts. Evidence: eval framework rollout 2026-03-05 used schema-creator as canary before applying FULL/LIGHT tiers to 7 other creator skills.
